response.justification: Bogdan is a strong match: 18+ years of software development with deep full-stack experience in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and MongoDB, plus current hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work — a rare and explicitly required skill. He demonstrates a testing-first craftsmanship mindset (TDD, CI/CD, test frameworks he authored) and cloud/container experience (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes). Notably, he is currently employed at re:cinq, which appears to be the hiring organization — worth clarifying internally. Gaps are minor: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin, or Python experience, though his polyglot background suggests fast ramp-up.
strengths: Extensive full-stack TypeScript/Node.js/React experience across multiple product companies
Current AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience, directly matching a required skill
Strong testing and craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, ran testing workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience listed from the primary stack
